claims: The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon will take place on Sunday, November 1, 2026.
The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon features over 50,000 runners.
Runners in the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon traverse all five boroughs.
Entry Application Window for the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is February 4–25, 2026.
Member-Only Second-Chance Drawing for the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is March 4, 2026.
The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors.
Applications for the non-guaranteed drawing for the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon are open from February 4–25, 2026.
Finishers of nine designated NYRR races and one volunteer shift in 2025 earn entry to the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon via the 9+1 program.
Guaranteed entry to the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is available through official charity partners such as PAWS NY.
Guaranteed entry to the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is available for international participants through international tour operators.
Runner's World and Facebook users note that recent lotteries had acceptance rates of 1% or less.
